posts.title: Two Acres Looked the Same. Only One Was Two Lots.
posts.desc: Two fictional buyers near retirement each consider a two-acre listing advertised as more than one lot. Legal lots, merger rules, wetlands, costs and a walk-away — a diligence story, not a return promise.
posts.imageAlt: A wooden fence dividing a green meadow, with a small white house on a distant hill

posts.title: The Buyer's Market With No Buyers
posts.desc: Redfin counts a record 62.6% more sellers than buyers in September 2026, yet buying has rarely been harder. What the gap really measures: mortgage rates, lock-in and the renters waiting on the sidelines.
posts.imageAlt: A quiet sage-green suburban house with a freshly mowed lawn and mature trees
